maml:description.maml:para: Creates a PARClient password file

Runs PARClient.exe /CreatePassFile to create a file containing an encrypted password, for use with the PassFile parameter of other module functions. PARClient prompts for the password interactively in the console; the password cannot be supplied as a parameter. PARClient prompts again until the new and confirmed passwords match. The password is not validated against any vault when the file is created. An existing file at the specified path is overwritten. The created file is only valid on the computer on which it was created. The parent folder of the file is created if it does not exist.
Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.
The path of the password file to create
Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet is not run.
